listings.description: Used 1983 Catalina 30 fiberglass cruising sailboat (30.0 ft LOA, 10.1 ft beam, 5.3 ft fin keel draft) listed through Shoreline Yacht Group in Long Beach, California. The listing states the owner relocated to Arizona and is motivated to sell, and describes the boat as ready to sail with recent upgrades in the last two years including a rebuilt engine (<50 hours), new batteries, charger, gas tank, water heater, fresh water pump, macerator, and a dodger frame.
